items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: this is when we got a chance to make some records with whoever was in town, Billie Holiday or whatnot.

ctx.x: To just sit down and just play.
Just sit down [unintelligible] and this is when we got a chance to make some records with whoever was in town, Billie Holiday or whatnot. Teddy Wilson and I were friends from Chicago.
Just on that point now, making records was different somewhat.
